clips.title: The story
paras: Klockmort's Creation marks the successful forging of a specialized suit of armor in Ironforge's Tinker Town. Utilizing an unconventional technique devised by the master armorsmith Furen Longbeard, the gnome blacksmith Klockmort Spannerspan shapes raw materials into an extraordinarily resilient piece of gear.

Forging heavy armor typically belongs to the great anvils of the Great Forge, but Klockmort Spannerspan operates out of Tinker Town. The creation of this armor represents a collaborative triumph between dwarven metallurgical tradition and gnomish mechanical innovation. By adapting Furen Longbeard's rigorous methods, Klockmort finishes a pair of armored gauntlets engineered to endure punishment that would crush ordinary steel.

According to Klockmort, the resulting armor boasts structural integrity so great that a siege engine could roll directly over it without causing permanent distortion. The secret lies in the peculiar treatment of rare components, proving that combining ancient dwarven forging techniques with gnomish ingenuity yields armor capable of withstanding the fiercest frontline battles.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here's your armor, friend. Furen's process worked brilliantly! Perfectly! Marvelously, truly!
You could run this armor over with a siege engine and it would spring right back into shape!
